title: RUNG 0's composition snapshot diffs main...git_head, which names main's tip at audit time, not the audited change
summary: Found while fixing carry-accepts-audit-bound-on-rebase-target (2026-09-28). A clean replay without an explanation version reaches RUNG 0 (ship_recovery.go, compositionCarryForward). Its snapshot (readCompositionSnapshot in cmd/evolve/cmd_composition_wiring.go) diffs `main...` + the auditor row's git_head and records git_head as AuditedBase. recordAuditBinding resolves git_head at the project root, so it is a commit on main, and the lane's audited change is uncommitted in its worktree: the three-dot diff is not the audited change, so RUNG 0 cannot carry a real rebase. Ship holds the same belief on the verifying side: internal/phases/ship/composition.go compares a composition record's AuditedBase with the bound row's git_head, so a snapshot rebuilt on the worktree base would be refused at ship unless that check moves with it. This is the belief ADR-0105 B3's carry had until the auditor row gained worktree_base_sha; auditledger.Entry.AuditedBase is now the one projection of the audited base, and both sides should read it. First measure how often a rebased ship reaches RUNG 0 (ExplanationDocumentationVersion == 0) and what it has carried since the worktree flow. Then either retire RUNG 0 in favor of B3's identity carry (which proves the tree-level change from worktree_tree_sha on worktree_base_sha), or rebuild the snapshot from those two fields.
acceptance: The RUNG 0 path either proves the audited change from worktree_tree_sha on auditledger.Entry.AuditedBase, with ship's composition check (internal/phases/ship/composition.go) reading the same projection, or is removed with B3's carry serving its callers
A test drives a rebased ship with no explanation version whose main moved before the audit, and it ships on the audited verdict or re-audits for a stated reason
ADR-0105 and the design doc §5.8 name the outcome
source: console, 2026-09-28, the audited-base fix for ADR-0105 B3
priority_rationale: The same replicated belief B3 carried (git_head is the audited base); a RUNG 0 that cannot carry costs a re-audit per rebased ship on that path
